colors.name: butter
colors.role: page background — the warm page of the picture book; carries ink at 11.6:1

colors.name: cream
colors.role: lightest wash — card fills, the sky behind the hero; ink on it 12.3:1

colors.name: sky
colors.role: card surface A — a soft sky; ink on it 9.7:1

colors.name: peach
colors.role: card surface B — warm peach; ink on it 9.2:1

colors.name: grape
colors.role: card surface C — cool grape; ink on it 8.1:1, plum only for large text (3.6:1)

colors.name: ink
colors.role: all functional text, outlines, the squash outline — 8.1–13.0:1 on every pastel (AAA body)

colors.name: ink-soft
colors.role: secondary text, captions — 4.95:1 minimum (AA body, weakest on grape)

colors.name: plum
colors.role: accent text and links, the bouncing title fill — 4.10–5.77:1 (AA body except 3.60:1 large-only on grape); white on it 5.77:1 (footer block)

colors.name: accent
colors.role: the CTA surface and the spring's blush — never text (1.45–2.32:1); carries ink type at 5.59:1

fonts.role: Latin display + body — the chunky rounded sans; every English word
every Hangul glyph — a hand-drawn rounded Korean face; Latin stacks fall through into it

texture: Softness is the only texture. No grain, no noise — instead rounded everything (border-radius scales from 12px chips to 999px pills and blobs), and soft offset drop-shadows built from layered ink-alpha steps (e.g. 0 4px 0 rgba(58,42,77,.10), 0 10px 22px rgba(58,42,77,.12)) that read as a rubber object resting on the page. Pastel surfaces are flat fills; depth comes from the shadows + a single 3px ink outline on pressable things (buttons, cards) so the squash-and-stretch has an edge to deform against. ::selection is plum-on-butter.

motion.name: spring-press
motion.value: active: scale(.92, .82) in ~1 frame; release: critically-underdamped spring back to 1 — stiffness 380, damping 14, mass 1 (overshoot ~6%, settles ~520ms). Squash on press (tall squeeze), stretch on release (slight overshoot tall).

motion.name: spring-stiff
motion.value: stiffness 220, damping 18 — card/springy settle, used for the bounce-in settle after reveal

motion.name: char-reveal
motion.value: per-glyph: translateY(0.5em→0) + scale(.6→1) via underdamped spring (stiffness 320, damping 12), staggered 55ms per glyph, triggered on intersection

motion.name: float-drift
motion.value: background shapes lerp toward pointer offset by depth factor 0.04–0.10 (lerp 0.06/frame, 60fps-normalized), capped at ±18px; plus idle bob 0 0 ±6px on 4.2–7.3s mutually-prime periods

motion.name: card-pop
motion.value: cards translateY(28px→0)+scale(.94→1) with spring-stiff, batch-staggered 90ms on reveal

motion.name: bob
motion.value: idle ambient: titles and badges bob ±2deg / ±4px on mutually-prime 5.1s / 6.4s periods so the page is never still
